changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`

- names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Every one of the six is read by `normalizeSeries` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts:242-255`) and does real work in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — `label` names the legend entry, `variant === 'comparison'` selects the muted overlay, `opacity` / `dashArray` set stroke and fill, `stack` becomes Recharts' `stackId`, `yAxis` binds the secondary axis. Any consumer of the parse output — `objectui check` / `objectui validate` via `safeValidateSchema`, a JSON schema derived from the mirror, or any pipeline that keeps `parse()`'s result — lost them outright.

### `.changeset/7694-chart-series-chart-type-alias-refusal.md`

- names `normalizeChartSchema.ts` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` — edited by this change

  > `chartType` is the renderer's INTERNAL spelling of `type`: the first limb of `normalizeSeries`' `str(raw.chartType) ?? str(raw.type)` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts`), written by the internal-shape producers that hand `dataKey`-shaped arrays straight to `ChartRenderer` (`ObjectChart`, `DatasetWidget`; `core/utils/chart-presentation` translates authored `type` *into* it) and by nothing an author writes. Re-measured at implementation time, series-level, with lit controls (`dataKey` / `name` / `type` / `color`): docs 0, fixtures 0, designer inputs 0 (the `chart` registration's `series` is one `code` input), src literals 0, tests 9 — every one an internal-shape array that never meets this mirror. Limb ablation over 304 files / 5817 tests: deleting `str(raw.chartType) ??` left all green; deleting the `?? str(raw.type)` sibling went 2 red.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c3a26ccda` (merge-base with origin/main): 5 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1562 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2149 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36290314196)

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aba42ccff019a9eddb9daa8ee6a1c75da874ab72`

Read: card objectui#10721 body and its three comments (triage `5851670156`, claim `5851777490`; the `os-dev-report` `5852185051` was not used as evidence), objectui#10691 body and its triage `5837770949`, PR 10742 body / file list / check-runs, the diff from `refs/review/main` (`c3a26ccda`, which is the merge-base) to `refs/review/pr-10742`, objectui `AGENTS.md` (版本号策略, Housekeeping changeset rule, #2, #11) and `.changeset/config.json`. Spec note: `/home/user/objectui` carries no `node_modules`, so `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` is not installed at the path the brief names; `ChartConfig.yAxis` was read instead from the sibling spec source at the same version, `/home/user/objectstack/packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts` (`package.json` `version` 17.4.0): `yAxis: z.array(ChartAxisSchema).optional()`, uncapped, as the card and both triages state.

### ① Derived judgments

Diff: 6 files, +270 / −38, two commits (`1dd700434` implementation; `aba42ccff` merge of `origin/main` `c3a26ccda`). Every `file:line` below is at the head.

1. Scatter slice expressed inside `placeYAxes` — `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:522-528` and `556-559`. Signature `placeYAxes(yAxes, chartType: string | undefined)`; `valueAxesRunAcross = chartType === 'horizontal-bar'` (526); `valueAxisCount = chartType === 'scatter' ? 1 : 2` (527); `entries = slice(0, valueAxisCount)` (528); `boundTo = valueAxisCount === 1 ? slotOf[0] : 'right'` (556); every entry past `entries.length` listed in `undrawn` with that `boundTo` (557-559). RIGHT: this is the triage's own spelling, 「The cleanest spelling expresses the scatter slice inside `placeYAxes`, so its `undrawn` list carries the entry」. Placement rules 1-4 (530-553) are untouched by the diff.

2. Renderer no longer pre-slices — `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:1789-1790`: `categoriesRunDown = chartType === 'horizontal-bar'`; `yPlacement = placeYAxes(yAxes, chartType)`, replacing base's `placeYAxes(chartType === 'scatter' ? yAxes?.slice(0, 1) : yAxes, categoriesRunDown)`. It is the same `chartType` variable the base scatter check read (the effective family). `effectiveChartFamily` (`normalizeChartSchema.ts:756-765`) returns `'scatter'` unchanged because `comboBaseFamily('scatter')` is undefined, so a scatter never widens into a combo. RIGHT.

3. The scatter note — `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:711-731`. `oneValueAxis = placement.slotOf.length === 1` (714); when true, one `p role="note" data-chart-note="y-axis-undrawn"` per undrawn entry reading 「`yAxis[N]` is not drawn — this chart draws one value axis, `yAxis[0]`」, with `against = placement[note.boundTo]` (718), which on scatter is `placement[slotOf[0]]`, always `0`. `oneValueAxis` is exact: `undrawn` is non-empty only when `yAxes.length` exceeds `entries.length`, so `slotOf.length` is the family's slot count, one on scatter and two elsewhere. Composed into `yPositionNote` (1804-1807), which the scatter arm hands to `ChartFootnote` (2487-2489); `ChartFootnote` (864-872) renders the note in a `div` after its children, i.e. under the plot. RIGHT against 「an entry past the first gets a visible note naming `yAxis[N]` through the same `ChartFootnote` channel」. The two-slot branch (733-752) is textually identical to base; only the `const field` line moved below the new `if`.

4. `hasNoNumericSeriesValue` — `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:3070` and `3079`. It returns `null` at 3070 for any family outside `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES` (`bar`, `horizontal-bar`, `line`, `area`, `combo`; 2929-2931), so on scatter `placeYAxes` is never reached; for those five families `placeYAxes(yAxes, chartType)` derives the same `horizontal-bar` predicate the base passed. Its answer is unchanged. RIGHT.

5. Normalizer derived-series binding — `normalizeChartSchema.ts:682-696`: `placeYAxes(yAxes, chartType)` (683), `slotOfEntry = [...slotOf, ...undrawn.map(boundTo)]` (686), a derived series gets `yAxis: slot` when the slot is `'right'` or the entry index is above 0 (693). On scatter a series derived from entry 1 or later now binds `'left'` (the drawn slot); at base it bound `'right'`, because the base normalizer never sliced and placed two entries. Judgment: in-scope correction, not an unasked change. The triage directs the slice into `placeYAxes`, whose `undrawn` list is what the normalizer binds from (objectui#10691's one-answer design; `YAxisUndrawnNote.boundTo` at 459-464 is the slot the derived series binds to 「and so the axis its `field` is plotted against」). On scatter the only axis is `slotOf[0]`; keeping `'right'` would name a slot the chart does not draw. Every reader of that binding at head: `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:1810` and `1856` (gated on `hasDualAxis`, false on scatter because `placement.right` is never set, 1791-1797); `2654-2661` (combo arm only); `2832-2833` (bar / line / area arm, gated on `hasDualAxis`); `3084` (`hasNoNumericSeriesValue`, scatter excluded). The scatter arm (2433-2490) reads `series[0].dataKey` (2450) and `yAxes?.[0]` (2477), never `s.yAxis`. Outside the package no runtime module calls `normalizeChartSchema`: `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts` names it in comments only and imports nothing from plugin-charts; the other hits are tests and zod `describe` prose. So no output a user sees moves. What does move: the published `normalizeChartSchema` result `series[N].yAxis` for a scatter whose series are derived from entries after the first, `'left'` in place of `'right'`; disclosed in the PR body (H2) and in the changeset's 「One answer」 bullet. When two or more entries carry a `field` and no `series` / `categories` is authored, the scatter arm refuses at 2437 (more than one series, `scatter-multi-series`) before any binding is read, and the pin's refusal control covers that case.

6. Two-slot families byte-identical — verified at source. For any `chartType` other than `'scatter'`: `valueAxisCount` is 2, so `entries = slice(0, 2)` as at base; `boundTo` is `'right'` as at base; `valueAxesRunAcross` is `chartType === 'horizontal-bar'`, the exact predicate every base caller passed (renderer via `categoriesRunDown`, the guard, the normalizer). Rules 1-4 untouched, so for 1 to 4 entries, `position` conflicts (`'side'` and `'taken'` notes) included, the placement, `notes`, `undrawn` indices and `boundTo` `'right'` are unchanged; the two-slot note JSX is unchanged. ⛔ 「no change to what a two-slot family (bar, line, area, combo, `horizontal-bar`) draws or notes」 holds.

7. Not narrowed, no new prop — no schema, zod, `RENDERABLE` or `CHART_TYPES` edit; `AdvancedChartImplProps` gains no member (only the `yAxes` doc comment, 324-331, changes). ⛔ 「no narrowing of `yAxis`」 and ⛔ 「no new published prop」 hold.

8. Existing pin edited — `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.yAxisUndrawn-10691.test.tsx:175` and `185`: `placeYAxes(axes, false)` becomes `placeYAxes(axes, 'bar')`. `'bar'` yields run-across false and count 2, the same answer `false` gave. No assertion moves; the flip follows the signature and weakens no guard. No pin is deleted.

9. New pin — `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.scatterYAxisUndrawn-10721.test.tsx`. Positive legs: two entries with authored `series` → exactly one note naming `['yAxis[1]', 'yAxis[0]']`, no `data-chart-error`, `Revenue` the only axis title, no right-side ticks, left top tick below `Units`' `max` 1000 (93-104); three entries → two notes in index order and note kinds exactly two `y-axis-undrawn` (106-117). Controls: one-entry scatter → no note (120-124; the negative leg); `line` with the same three entries → today's one note `['yAxis[2]', 'series', 'categories', 'visits', 'yAxis[1]']` (126-132; the lit control that the channel works); three entries without `series` → `scatter-multi-series` refusal and zero notes (134-138; the triage's 「derived-series refusal as the visible control」). Unit legs: `placeYAxes(axes, 'scatter')` → `slotOf ['left']`, `undrawn [{1, 'left'}, {2, 'left'}]`, and the normalizer's derived series carry `yAxis: note.boundTo` (141-153); first entry at `position: 'right'` → `slotOf ['right']`, `undrawn [{1, 'right'}]` (155-160). Can fail: at base the renderer pre-sliced so `undrawn` was empty (0 notes; `toHaveLength(1)` / `(2)` fail), and base `placeYAxes` took a boolean, so `'scatter'` read as truthy run-across and placed two entries (`slotOf` of length 2; `toEqual(['left'])` and `toEqual(['right'])` fail). The file matches `tsconfig.test.json` `include` `src/**/*.test.tsx`. The ask 「Pin a two-entry and a three-entry `scatter` with authored `series`」 is met.

10. Missing: nothing asked is missing. `Fixes #10721` is the body's first line.

11. Not asked: (a) one docs sentence at `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx:231`, outside the claim's file surface, judged in ②; (b) doc-comment updates in the two source files; (c) the normalizer binding, judged in item 5. Nothing else.

12. The note's wording — every `data-chart-note` sentence in the channel at head is a JSX English literal: `x-axis-position` (593-600), `y-axis-position` (668-679), `y-axis-undrawn` both arms (721-731, 735-752), `unsized-rows` (1006-1010), `unplotted-points` (1415-1420), `omitted-rows` (2363-2372). The only catalogue string in the scatter arm is `tt('chart.scatterOneMeasure', …)` inside `SeriesArityRefusal` (1375-1378), a `ChartRefusal`, not a note. The new sentence follows the channel's own convention and bypasses no catalogue.
